battle.name: 第一次世界大戰
battle.brief: 一九一四年七月二十八日奧匈向塞爾維亞宣戰，四年戰爭席捲歐洲、中東與非洲。西線自北海至瑞士拉出約六百公里壕溝，MG 08重機槍以每分鐘五百發的水冷火力封鎖射界，成為德軍步兵連與營的火力骨幹，凡爾登等役中既是進攻的支柱，也是守軍的屏障。

kit.name: MG 08重機槍
kit.history: MG 08在一次大戰的西線和東線被廣泛部署，其持續的火力在防守與進攻中均發揮了重要作用。

countries: 第一次世界大戰由兩大對立陣營在歐洲、中東、非洲與亞洲的廣大戰區同時展開。協約國以法蘭西第三共和國、大英帝國與俄羅斯帝國為核心：法軍由總參謀部在霞飛指揮下執行面向西北與東南的兩個作戰計畫，英軍由帝國總參謀部與新組成的陸軍野戰軍分頭負責西線北段與巴勒斯坦、伊拉克方向，俄軍由最高統帥部統率東線與高加索方向。1915年義大利倒向協約國，1916年羅馬尼亞、1917年美國與希臘相繼參戰，另有塞爾維亞、比利時、葡萄牙、蒙特內哥羅等國以原有軍隊直接作戰。同盟國方面由德意志帝國、奧匈帝國與鄂圖曼帝國組成，1915年保加利亞加入；德軍以皇帝威廉二世統率、總參謀部（小毛奇、其後法爾肯海因與魯登道夫）策劃作戰，奧匈由弗朗茨·約瑟夫與康拉德·霍岑多夫分掌軍政，鄂圖曼由恩維爾·帕夏主持戰局。戰區可分西線（北海至瑞士）、東線、巴爾干、加里波利、巴勒斯坦、美索不達米亞、東非、西非與海上，其中封鎖戰、潛艇獵殺與南中國海巡弋同樣是長期消耗的戰線。據戰後統計，各國動員兵員至少六千七百萬人。
countriesEn: The First World War was fought by two opposing blocs across a series of theaters in Europe, the Middle East, Africa and Asia. The Entente was built around the French Third Republic, the British Empire and the Russian Empire: the French army operated two plans under the General Headquarters commanded by Joffre, the British army split its northern Western Front commitment and its Palestine and Mesopotamia theaters between the Imperial General Staff and the newly created General Staff of the British Army, and the Russian army was directed by the Stavka on the Eastern and Caucasian fronts. Italy came over to the Entente in 1915, Romania in 1916, the United States and Greece in 1917, and Serbia, Belgium, Portugal and Montenegro fought with their existing forces. The Central Powers consisted of Germany, Austria-Hungary and the Ottoman Empire, with Bulgaria joining in 1915; the German army was nominally under Emperor Wilhelm II with the General Staff (Moltke the Younger, then Falkenhayn and later Ludendorff) planning operations, Austria-Hungary divided command between Franz Joseph and Conrad von Hötzendorf, and the Ottoman war was directed by Enver Pasha. The theaters can be listed as the Western Front from the Channel to Switzerland, the Eastern Front, the Balkans, Gallipoli, Palestine, Mesopotamia, East and West Africa, and the sea, where the blockade, the submarine campaign and the South China Sea patrol were all fronts of a long attrition. According to postwar counting, at least 67 million men were mobilized by the participating states.
people: 德國方面，威廉二世是名義上的最高統帥，總參謀長小毛奇策劃施里芬計畫，法爾肯海因接任後負責執行，1916年凡爾登攻勢的批准者是魯登道夫與興登堡，興登堡自1914年坦嫩堡戰役後主持東線；宰相貝特曼·霍爾維希在七月危機中批准對奧匈的「空白支票」，其後下達的停戰命令成為大戰擴大的關鍵一步。法國方面，克列孟梭自1917年出任總理主持戰時政府，凡爾登防區先後由沙爾·德·卡斯泰爾諾與菲利普·貝當鎮守，1917年秋季的尼維爾攻勢由尼維爾策劃，並以霞飛戰區指揮權的交接收場。英國方面，勞合·喬治與費德倫·菲森分別掌管內政與海軍，菲森推動主力艦與潛艇政策，陸軍大臣道格拉斯·黑斯廷斯力主陸軍野戰軍獨立，菲登元帥自1916年接掌西線主力。俄國方面，尼古拉二世兼任最高統帥，1915年由雅科夫列夫接任參謀總長，布魯西洛夫元帥於1916年發動東線最大攻勢。奧匈有康拉德與參謀總長施蒂爾岑，義大利在卡波雷托慘敗後由卡羅爾迪整頓軍務，鄂圖曼有恩維爾與傑瓦希爾，遠征軍美軍由潘興率領，澳紐軍團則以加里波利登陸與1918年哈梅爾戰役的滲透戰術聞名。兵器方面，MG 08 屬德國萊茵金屬的設計，設計者路易·施邁瑟一說在德國檔案與後世敘述間略有出入，其母型則是英國 Maxim 的 Maxim MG 08。
peopleEn: On the German side Wilhelm II was the nominal supreme commander; Moltke the Younger planned the Schlieffen Plan, Falkenhayn took over its execution, the order for the 1916 Verdun offensive came from Ludendorff and Hindenburg, and Hindenburg directed the Eastern Front after the victory at Tannenberg in 1914; Chancellor Bethmann Hollweg approved the blank cheque for Austria-Hungary during the July Crisis, and the halt order he issued afterwards was the decisive step in the war's expansion. In France Clemenceau became prime minister in 1917 and ran the war cabinet, the Verdun sector was held successively by General de Castelnau and Philippe Pétain, and the Nivelle offensive of autumn 1917 was planned by Nivelle and ended with the transfer of command in that sector. In Britain Lloyd George and Admiral Fisher ran home affairs and the navy, Fisher pushed the capital ship and submarine programmes, Secretary of State for War Douglas Haig argued for an independent British field army, and Field Marshal Haig took command of the main Western Front force in 1916. In Russia Nicholas II was supreme commander, Yakovlev became chief of the general staff in 1915, and Marshal Brusilov launched the largest offensive of the Eastern Front in 1916. Austria-Hungary had Conrad and the chief of staff von Hötzendorf, Italy reorganized its army after the disaster at Caporetto under Cadorna, the Ottomans had Enver and Cemal Pasha, the American Expeditionary Force was led by John Pershing, and the Australian and New Zealand forces became famous for the Gallipoli landings and the infiltration tactics of the 1918 attack at Hamel. On the weapons side the MG 08 was developed at Rheinmetall, with the design attributed to Louis Schmeisser although the exact credit is disputed in German files and later accounts; its parent pattern is the British Maxim's Maxim MG 08.
kits: MG 08 是德軍的制式重機槍，1908年定型，1910年起大量列裝，以英國 Maxim 的 Maxim MG 08 為母型，使用七點九二乘五十七毫米毛瑟彈，連發時每分鐘五百發、實用射速約四百發，有效射程約八百米，槍身重約四十公斤、槍管長約八百毫米，靠水冷套筒散熱，彈藥以一百發彈鏈供彈（亦有二百五十發彈鏈），架於三腳架上，配備輕型與重型雪橇式底座以便拖行越過鐵絲網，後來的 MG 08/15 與 MG 08/18 即由標準型改裝而來；一挺 MG 08 連同底座、水箱與備件的整組重近百公斤，通常由六至八人分擔，包括槍長、瞄手、裝填手與送彈手，每個步兵營約配數挺。在整體火力體系中，它同七點七厘米野戰砲、10.5厘米輕型榴彈砲、十五厘米重榴彈砲、戰壕迫擊砲、毒氣與噴火器並列；單兵用 Gewehr 98 步槍，另有馱馬、載重汽車與軍用列車負責補給。其他交戰方的重機槍各有來歷：英國 Vickers 與 Maxim、法國哈奇開斯 8mm、俄國莫辛-拿甘的 Maxim 型 7.62mm、奧匈 Schwarzlose 7.92mm、義大利 Fiat-Revelli 6.5mm；更上一層還有坦克、飛機、潛水艇與齊柏林飛艇這些新裝備，MG 08 恰是它們出現之前步兵師最可靠也最吃重的火力骨幹。
kitsEn: The MG 08 was the standard heavy machine gun of the German army, finalized in 1908 and fielded in quantity from 1910. It was built on the British Maxim's Maxim MG 08 and fired the 7.92x57mm Mauser cartridge at 500 rounds a minute in automatic fire, with a practical rate near 400 rounds, an effective range of about 800 metres, a weight of roughly 40 kilograms and a barrel of about 800 millimetres, the heat carried away by a water jacket. Ammunition was fed in 100-round belts, with 250-round belts also in use, and the gun stood on a tripod, with light and heavy sled mounts so that it could be dragged forward across wire obstacles; the later MG 08/15 and MG 08/18 were converted from the standard pattern. A complete MG 08 with mount, water and accessories weighed close to 100 kilograms and was normally handled by six to eight men, including the gun commander, the layer, the loader and ammunition carriers, and an infantry battalion was allotted several guns. In the wider firepower system it stood alongside the 7.7cm field gun, the 10.5cm light field howitzer, the 15cm heavy field howitzer, trench mortars, poison gas and flamethrowers; the individual soldier carried the Gewehr 98 rifle, while pack horses, lorries and military trains carried the supplies. The other belligerents had heavy machine guns of their own: the British Vickers and Maxim, the French Hotchkiss 8mm, the Russian Maxim-pattern 7.62mm on the Mosin-Nagant, the Austrian Schwarzlose 7.92mm, the Italian Fiat-Revelli 6.5mm; above them all stood the new arms, tanks, aircraft, submarines and rigid airships. The MG 08 was exactly the most reliable and most weighty fire backbone the infantry division possessed before those new weapons appeared.
tactics: 西線很快由運動戰轉入壕溝對峙，兩軍塹壕線相距數百米甚至更近，MG 08 架在射擊台與掩體內，以交叉火力控制塹壕前的通道，步兵若在白晝躍進便會被側射火力壓倒，任何正面衝鋒都被視為送死。突破的做法因此變成工程問題：先用長達數日的密集砲火準備，再用游動彈幕讓步兵以「火力與移動」交替前進；掘進隊在夜間挖坑道貼近敵陣，排雷兵剪開鐵絲網並擲出炸藥包，同時以機槍與迫擊砲曲射壓制敵方機槍陣地。1916年後澳紐軍團與英軍在小規模目標上試行滲透出擊，1917年德軍胡梯爾戰術與突擊兵制度成形，1918年三月魯登道夫春季攻勢把突破線預備、集中砲火與步兵滲透結合，使防守方的 MG 08 陣地屢被繞過。戰車自1916年9月首次投入實戰、1917年康布雷以數百輛集群使用，航空亦從偵察與砲兵校射升格為獨立的兵種。海戰方面，潛艇封鎖與反潛護航在兩個方向上同時拉鋸，後勤線則在四年消耗戰中不斷拉長，餵馬與糧秣的短缺更在1917年迫使德軍以步兵行軍代替部分馬車輸送。
tacticsEn: On the Western Front the war quickly turned from a war of movement into a trench stalemate, the two trench lines often only a few hundred metres apart or less. MG 08s were set up on firing platforms and in emplacements, covering the approaches to the enemy trench with crossfire, and any daylight rush by infantry was beaten down by enfilading fire; frontal attacks were regarded as simple murder. Breaking through therefore became a matter of engineering: long days of preparatory bombardment first, then a creeping barrage that let infantry alternate between fire and movement; sapping teams dug galleries toward the enemy position at night, engineers cut the wire and threw explosive charges forward, and machine guns and mortars were used in high arc fire to silence the enemy machine-gun positions. After 1916 the Australian and New Zealand formations and the British army practised infiltration attacks on small objectives, and in 1917 the German Hutier tactics and the stormtrooper system took shape. In March 1918 Ludendorff's spring offensive combined prepared breach lines, concentrated artillery and infantry infiltration, so that defending MG 08 positions were repeatedly turned and bypassed. Tanks first saw action in September 1916 and were used in several hundred at Cambrai in 1917, and aviation rose from spotting and gun-laying to a service in its own right. At sea, the submarine blockade and the anti-submarine escort fought each other out in both directions, and on the ground the supply lines stretched longer and longer through four years of attrition, with shortages of fodder and grain forcing the German army in 1917 to substitute infantry marching for part of its horse-drawn transport.
data: 規模數字：各國動員兵員至少六千七百萬人，軍人陣亡約一千萬、受傷約二千萬；戰爭自1914年7月28日奧匈向塞爾維亞宣戰起，至1918年11月11日上午十一時停戰生效，歷時四年三個月又十四天。西線自北海至瑞士延伸約六百至七百公里，塹壕總長以數萬公里計；凡爾登自1916年2月21日夜德軍開火至同年12月18日停火，前後十個月，戰線只推進數公里，雙方傷亡以數十萬計，各家統計自六十餘萬至七十餘萬不等；索姆河1916年7月1日開戰，首日英軍傷亡逾五萬。兵器數字：MG 08 連發射速每分鐘五百發、有效射程約八百米、槍重約四十公斤、供彈鏈一百發、槍管長約八百毫米，一挺機槍連射十分鐘即耗彈五千發，因此射擊時機被嚴格管制。裝備數量：至1918年底德軍序列內 MG 08 系列逾一萬二千挺（各版本統計略有出入），英軍 Vickers 一型在1914至1918年間生產逾五萬挺；加里波利自1915年2月至1916年1月打了八個月，參戰雙方傷亡各以數十萬計；布魯西洛夫1916年東線攻勢推進約五百公里，俘虜約六十萬人。關於這些數字，各方檔案的統計口徑不一，宜作量級參考。
dataEn: On the scale: at least 67 million men were mobilized by the belligerents, with roughly 10 million military dead and 20 million wounded; the war ran from the Austro-Hungarian declaration of war on Serbia on 28 July 1914 to the armistice taking effect at 11 a.m. on 11 November 1918, a span of four years, three months and fourteen days. The Western Front stretched some six to seven hundred kilometres from the Channel to Switzerland, with the trench lines running to tens of thousands of kilometres in total. Verdun burned from the German opening bombardment on the night of 21 February 1916 until the ceasefire of 18 December in the same year, ten months for a front that moved only a few kilometres, with casualties in the hundreds of thousands; published totals range from a little over 600,000 to more than 700,000. On the Somme, 1 July 1916 brought more than 50,000 British casualties in the opening day. On the weapon: the MG 08 fired 500 rounds a minute, had an effective range near 800 metres, weighed about 40 kilograms, was fed by 100-round belts and had an 800-millimetre barrel; ten minutes of continuous fire from one gun consumed 5,000 rounds, which is why the timing of fire was strictly controlled. On equipment holdings: by the end of 1918 the German army had more than 12,000 MG 08-pattern guns in service, with slightly differing figures between the various counts, while Britain produced over 50,000 Vickers between 1914 and 1918. Gallipoli ran from February 1915 to January 1916 over eight months with casualties in the hundreds of thousands on both sides, and Brusilov's offensive of 1916 carried the Eastern Front some 500 kilometres and took about 600,000 prisoners. The accounting methods behind these figures differ from source to source, so they are best read as orders of magnitude.
cause: 打起來的原因分遠近兩層。遠因是二十世紀初歐洲體系的收緊：1882年的三國同盟與1907年成形的三國協約把國家綁在兩套互不相容的承諾鏈上，德國與英國的海軍競賽把預算與艦隊綁在一起，泛斯拉夫主義與波蘭問題、民族主義與殖民地爭奪使彼此的猜忌年年加深，巴爾干則因為1908至1909年的波斯尼亞危機與1912至1913年的兩場巴爾干戰爭變成火藥桶。直接引爆是一九一四年六月二十八日薩拉熱窩的暗殺，加夫里洛·普林西普擊斃奧匈皇儲弗朗茨·斐迪南大公及其夫人；七月危機隨即爆發，奧匈在德國「空白支票」下向塞爾維亞下最後通牒，七月二十八日宣戰，俄羅斯總動員、法國動員、德國對俄對法宣戰、比利時中立被侵犯而英國於八月四日參戰，戰爭由巴爾干危機迅速升級成世界戰爭。制度與心理層面的失誤同樣關鍵：各國總參謀部把動員時刻表當作不可逆的按鈕，貝特曼·霍爾維希在德軍攻入法國後的暫停命令錯失了收手時機，1917年德國無限制潛艇戰又把美國拖進戰局。
causeEn: There were long-term and immediate causes. In the long run the European system of the early twentieth century tightened: the Triple Alliance of 1882 and the Triple Entente completed in 1907 tied states to two incompatible sets of promises; the naval race between Germany and Britain bound budgets to fleets; Pan-Slavism and the Polish question, nationalism and colonial rivalry deepened mutual suspicion year by year; and the Balkans became a powder barrel after the Bosnian crisis of 1908-1909 and the two Balkan wars of 1912-1913. The spark was the assassination in Sarajevo on 28 June 1914, when Gavrilo Princip killed the heir to the Austro-Hungarian throne, Archduke Franz Ferdinand and his wife. The July Crisis followed at once: backed by the German blank cheque, Austria-Hungary sent Serbia an ultimatum and declared war on 28 July; Russian general mobilization, French mobilization, the German declarations of war on Russia and on France, the violation of Belgian neutrality and finally British entry on 4 August turned a Balkan quarrel into a world war. Institutional and psychological errors mattered just as much: the general staffs of every country treated the mobilization timetable as a button that could not be unpressed, Bethmann Hollweg's halt order after the German advance into France missed the moment to stop, and Germany's unrestricted submarine warfare in 1917 dragged the United States into the war.
impact: 後果首先落在制度上：德意志帝國、奧匈帝國、俄羅斯帝國與鄂圖曼帝國全部解體，奧匈分成奧地利、匈牙利並催生捷克斯洛伐克、南斯拉夫與波蘭等新國家，俄國因布列寧領導的革命退出戰事並進入內戰，德國在十一月革命後改為共和國，土耳其在獨立戰爭後建立共和國。凡爾賽體系重劃歐洲疆界並強加賠款與軍備限制，國際聯盟在1920年成立，試圖以條約與集體安全取代均勢的平衡邏輯。軍隊與技術層面，重機槍確立了步兵班的核心火力地位，MG 08 的水冷連發模式被各國仿效，輕機槍則在1918年後成為新的分界，坦克、毒氣、獨立航空兵種與總動員體制都由此役定型；戰爭也把徵兵、工廠與戰地醫療推上一個新層次，婦女大量進入軍工崗位，英國於1918年通過代表法案、美國於1920年通過第十九修正案，投票權的版圖因此改變。理念上，「總體戰」與「消耗戰」取代了決戰的想象，殖民地士兵亦首次以大規模被編入歐洲戰場的方式參戰，戰爭的破壞規模使國際間不再相信可以靠一次總決戰解決爭端。
impactEn: The consequences came first to the structure of states: the German, Austro-Hungarian, Russian and Ottoman empires all broke up; Austria-Hungary split into Austria and Hungary and brought into being Czechoslovakia, Yugoslavia and Poland; Russia left the war under a revolution led by Lenin and moved into civil war; Germany became a republic after the November Revolution; Turkey founded a republic after its war of independence. The Versailles settlement redrew the map of Europe and imposed reparations and military limits, and the League of Nations was founded in 1920 in an attempt to replace the balance of power with treaties and collective security. At the level of arms and armies, the heavy machine gun established itself as the core firepower of the infantry section, and the water-cooled, belt-fed model of the MG 08 was copied across the belligerents, while the light machine gun marked the new dividing line after 1918; tanks, poison gas, an independent air service and the system of general mobilization were all shaped by this war. The war also pushed conscription, factory production and battlefield medicine to a new level, with women taking up large numbers of jobs in war industry; Britain's Representation of the People Act of 1918 and the Nineteenth Amendment to the United States Constitution in 1920 redrew the map of the vote. In ideas, the notion of total war and of war by attrition displaced the old image of a single decisive battle, and colonial troops were massed on the European fronts for the first time on this scale; the sheer destruction of the conflict left nobody believing that a single final battle could settle a dispute any more.
result: 結果是協約國勝利，同盟國在崩潰中尋求停戰。1918年8月以來德軍在協約國連續反攻下節節敗退，10月底起各戰線相繼崩解，11月9日德國代表在貢比涅簽署停戰條款，11月11日上午十一時槍聲在西線停止，四年三個月又十四天的戰爭畫上句號；之後凡爾賽條約於1919年6月28日簽訂，規定德國割讓亞爾薩斯-洛林、歸還殖民地面積、裁軍至十萬人並支付賠款，奧地利、匈牙利、鄂圖曼也分別在聖日耳曼、突尼斯、洛桑等條約中受處置。德國並依條約交出大批重機槍與火炮，MG 08 這類武器大部分被拆解封存或作為賠償物資流散他國，只有結構較簡的輕型雪橇版少量留用。俄羅斯早在1917年12月的布列斯特-立陶宛條約中就已退出戰局，帝國解體後的混亂延續多年。結果的另一面是秩序的重整：歐洲失去四個帝國與大量領土邊界，債務、通貨與傷殘者問題把多個國家推向新的政治組合，而在此役中嶄露的裝備與戰術經驗，又直接餵養了下一場更大規模的戰爭。史家多以「一切從這裡開始」形容其地位，儘管細節諸說並存，人們對此役的結束方式與新格局的共識則相當一致。
resultEn: The result was an Entente victory, with the Central Powers seeking an armistice as their structure came apart. After the Allied counter-offensives of August 1918 the German army collapsed front by front, the fronts broke up from late October, German representatives signed the armistice terms at Compiegne on 9 November, and the guns stopped on the Western Front at 11 a.m. on 11 November, ending four years, three months and fourteen days of fighting. The Treaty of Versailles followed on 28 June 1919, ceding Alsace-Lorraine, returning colonial territory, limiting the army to 100,000 men and setting reparations, and Austria, Hungary and the Ottoman Empire were separately disposed of at Saint-Germain, Trianon and Lausanne. Germany handed over large quantities of heavy machine guns and artillery under the treaties; most MG 08s were broken up, stored or dispersed abroad as reparation goods, and only the structurally simpler light sled version found limited further use. Russia had already left the war with the Treaty of Brest-Litovsk of December 1917, and the disorder that followed the breakup of the empire ran on for years. The other side of the result is a reordering of the order itself: Europe lost four empires and a great many frontiers, and questions of debt, currency and the disabled pushed several countries towards new political combinations, while the equipment and tactical experience of this war fed directly into the next and larger conflict. Historians often describe the war as the point from which everything followed, and although the details are disputed, the agreement on how the war ended and on the shape of the new order is remarkably broad.
